workflow_steps.title: Count hospitals by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Assign each hospital point to its containing Centre County census tract and compute the hospital count for each tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Count point features from input_1 within polygon features from input_2. Preserve the polygon features and add a hospital_count attribute containing the number of hospital points in each polygon.

workflow_steps.title: Create hospital count choropleth
workflow_steps.purpose: Create an interactive HTML choropleth showing hospital counts across Centre County census tracts.
workflow_steps.instructions: Generate an interactive HTML choropleth from counted_tracts using hospital_count as the classified visualization field. Include input_3 as a contextual county-subdivision boundary layer where supported, without replacing the census-tract choropleth geography.
